summary: Steep arterial kerb beside bush, with almost no parked cars.
reasons: Main road, no parking convention seen

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the south side; apartments 18 m or more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a through road, no shoulder or pull-in beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with a junction near the start.
drivers.convention: One car at the far end only; Traffic Area signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 9.5% grade here, 21.6% max on the stretch
sun_shade: Heavy bush canopy shades the section from the south and west.

best_section.where: Carmody Road south kerb, backing onto the bushland
